claim: Complete reproducible corpus used for the CutRight v2 decision; not an unbounded claim over every possible source.

sources.name: CutRight
sources.notice_requirements: First-party MIT project; dependency notices kept in third_party/.
sources.notes: Shipping base. Current external-provider assumptions are replaced by v2.

sources.name: Workspace capabilities
sources.notice_requirements: Per-file third-party notices preserved; per-root ledger rows in imports/v2/dispositions.json.
sources.notes: Designer plus Brand, Brand Identity, Content, Writing, Social, QA, bounded-run, eval topology, and selected local assets. PPTX/deck-only branches may be excluded only by an explicit ledger row.

sources.name: HeardRight
sources.notice_requirements: Third-party model notices mandatory; model assets resolved only from signed pack provenance.
sources.notes: Copy engine/core/platform source and only redistributable model assets into first-party CutRight packs.

sources.name: AutoShorts
sources.notice_requirements: Clean-room note with observed public behaviour, implementer separation, and no-copy attestation.
sources.notes: Reproduce project-library, onboarding, one-click-run, candidate-card, and progress behavior without copying source.

sources.name: Vox Director
sources.notice_requirements: MIT notice preserved in THIRD_PARTY.yml of every copied subtree.
sources.notes: Absorb beat/shot structure, style bake-offs, A/B/C-roll, anti-monotony, and bounded async job semantics.

sources.name: Palmier Pro
sources.notice_requirements: Clean-room note; GPL-3.0 source must never be copied into the MIT product.
sources.notes: Reimplement typed editing actions, stable IDs, composited inspection, undo, variants, jobs, and skill catalog without copying Swift.

sources.name: llama.cpp
sources.notice_requirements: MIT notice preserved; CutRight builds its own platform binaries into signed packs.
sources.notes: Pinned local inference runtime for director and vision critic.

sources.name: whisper.cpp
sources.notice_requirements: MIT notice preserved; selected model licence recorded separately in Book 3.
sources.notes: Independent transcript/edge verifier; never transcript authority.

sources.name: Silero VAD
sources.notice_requirements: Exact ONNX model bytes with generated SHA-256; MIT notice preserved.
sources.notes: Use exact ONNX model bytes with no network fallback; 8/16 kHz parity fixtures must pass.

sources.name: MediaPipe
sources.notice_requirements: Conditional component: telemetry-disabled, network-blocked qualification and per-model licence closure required before any vision-pack entry.
sources.notes: May provide face/pose tracking only after qualification; otherwise a qualified CutRight-owned fallback is used.

sources.name: FFmpeg n8.1
sources.notice_requirements: No --enable-gpl and no --enable-nonfree; installer carries the exact configure line and corresponding source.
sources.notes: LGPL-2.1-or-later configuration only.

sources.name: Qwen3-4B
sources.notice_requirements: In-house deterministic GGUF conversion; exact output hashes frozen by the pack builder; Apache-2.0 notice in the director pack.
sources.notes: Director candidate selected. Q4_K_M is a starting candidate; final quant selected by benchmark.

sources.name: Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct
sources.notice_requirements: In-house GGUF/mmproj conversion; ship only after all supported targets pass quality and memory floors.
sources.notes: Independent visual critic.

sources.name: Qwen3.5-4B
sources.notice_requirements: Qualification candidate only; never silently replaces selected models; requires a full pack-version and benchmark transition.
sources.notes: Not a shipping dependency until deterministic local runtime support passes the full matrix.

sources.name: Kokoro-82M v1.0
sources.notice_requirements: Model hash fixed; every voice and phonemizer asset must have its own provenance and redistribution entry.
sources.notes: TTS selected for local narration and preview speech.

sources.name: Attached Cutaway/Finish material
sources.notice_requirements: Materialized hash manifest generated in Book 1; third-party dependencies audited separately.
sources.notes: Scripts kept as golden behavior; live execution migrates to typed CutRight stages. The attachment manifest is materialized by CR-V2-B1-014 from the existing cutaway/ and finish/ tree at the pinned baseline.

sources.name: VideoLLaMB
sources.notice_requirements: Citation only; no code or data copied.
sources.notes: Hierarchical scene memory, not whole-video prompt stuffing.

sources.name: Flash-VStream
sources.notice_requirements: Citation only; no code or data copied.
sources.notes: Two-tier evidence store and selective frame retrieval.

sources.name: ProVideLLM
sources.notice_requirements: Citation only; no code or data copied.
sources.notes: Separate semantic summaries from high-resolution evidence.

sources.name: LVAgent
sources.notice_requirements: Citation only; no code or data copied.
sources.notes: Agent loop must retrieve, act, inspect, and revise.

sources.name: SALOVA
sources.notice_requirements: Citation only; no code or data copied.
sources.notes: Queries operate over indexed segments and retrieve bounded detail.

sources.name: Adaptive Keyframe Sampling
sources.notice_requirements: Citation only; no code or data copied.
sources.notes: Evidence sampling must balance query relevance and coverage.

sources.name: LongVALE
sources.notice_requirements: Citation only; no code or data copied.
sources.notes: Evidence graph has explicit audio/visual events and boundaries.

sources.name: VidHalluc
sources.notice_requirements: Citation only; no code or data copied.
sources.notes: Truthfulness and chronology checks are first-class.

sources.name: AVE-Compass
sources.notice_requirements: Citation only; no code or data copied.
sources.notes: Instruction, preservation, realism, edit-intent, and critic-revision axes.

sources.name: SpeechEditBench
sources.notice_requirements: Citation only; no code or data copied.
sources.notes: Every edit is scored for requested change and untouched-content preservation.

sources.name: UniEditBench
sources.notice_requirements: Citation only; no code or data copied.
sources.notes: Independent visual critic and multi-dimensional edit scoring.

sources.name: FiVE
sources.notice_requirements: Citation only; no code or data copied.
sources.notes: Object-level edit success is separated from non-target preservation.

sources.name: V2V-Bench
sources.notice_requirements: Citation only; no code or data copied.
sources.notes: Release reports separate evaluation dimensions instead of one aggregate score.

sources.name: AVID
sources.notice_requirements: Citation only; no code or data copied.
sources.notes: Critic tests include active-speaker, voiceover, scenic, and cross-modal conflict cases.

sources.name: TARO
sources.notice_requirements: Citation only; no code or data copied.
sources.notes: Transient alignment is evaluated at event/onset level.

sources.name: MMAudio
sources.notice_requirements: Citation only; no code or data copied.
sources.notes: Audio generation and SFX placement use frame/event alignment evidence.
